about.title: About KhelKhilone
about.intro: At KhelKhilone, we believe every child deserves toys that spark imagination, encourage learning, and create happy memories. Based in Akola, Maharashtra, we bring families a carefully selected range of toys for every age and adventure.
about.founderDescription: Our journey began with a simple idea: make choosing toys joyful, easy, and trustworthy for every family. We focus on playful discovery, helpful service, and products that inspire children to learn through play.
about.mission: To help children learn, imagine, and grow through joyful play while making toy shopping simple and dependable for parents.
about.vision: To be a trusted destination for families seeking thoughtful toys, friendly service, and a little more happiness in every day.
